Class StdIO

java.lang.Object
easyIO.StdIO
public class StdIO extends Object
Easy access to standard input and standard output, without fussing with exceptions. One easy way to use this is to make your class a subclass of StdIO. Or you can use a static import: 
    import static easyIO.StdIO.*;
    ...
This class is largely superseded in recent Java by the IO class.
